_comment: Copy to server/mcp.json to give Powered Souqi extra tools, or set the
same JSON as the MCP_SERVERS environment variable (env wins).
Eco Souqi never loads these — MCP is a Powered Souqi feature.
http  — give a `url` (+ optional `headers`) for a streamable-HTTP server
Set "enabled": false to keep an entry without loading it.
A server that fails to start is skipped with a warning; builds still run.
